401-3944-7286-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-7286-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

3525-7014-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to North Pole Patrol.
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
3525-7014-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
3525-7014-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 1

728-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
728-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

728-801-2757-3249.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Grimgrin, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Impulsive Pilferer, untapping a basic land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4247-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1170-3446-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

654-3129-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-3129-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2111-4779-6982.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

443-2946-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2946-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

883-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

372-813-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2281-2438-3817.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2292-4200-4681.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5310-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2932-3967-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2932-3967-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2932-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

215-2499-3390-3518-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2499-3390-3518-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

1379-3003-4231-5966-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
1379-3003-4231-5966-6753.description:
Cast Rory Williams by paying {W}{U}.
Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.

2187-4067-4306-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

290-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

527-6323.easyPrerequisites:
Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness
Selvala, Heart of the Wilds does not have summoning sickness.
527-6323.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding 10,000 mana in any combination of colors.

1-1786-5014-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

654-1170-1418-1645-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4094-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4094-4559-4740-5670.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1636-3143-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3143-3490.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

571-978-1429-4853.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
571-978-1429-4853.description:
Activate Oni-Cult Anvil by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Oni-Cult Anvil.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Oni-Cult Anvil ability, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

230-3002-4050-4365.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-3002-4050-4365.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

45-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Khalni Gem's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
45-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

751-1379-4050-4814.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Myr, adding {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself to its owner's hand.
Repeat.

1645-1765-2557-4050.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
